destination.title: Cosmological histories: origins, interpretation and consistency
destination.question: How are cosmological histories prepared, weighted, continued and tested, and what limits their classical or effective description?
destination.summary: The original membership joins several useful research directions but supplies no independently established scientific boundary. Initial-state probabilities, singularity continuation, initial-condition puzzles, observables, backreaction and EFT restrictions warrant separate navigation. Conjectural restrictions and contested assumptions remain locally qualified.

systems: Cosmological effective theories and alternative gravitational prescriptions
targets: Backreaction, vacuum energy and effective-theory control
regimes: Early, contracting, bouncing, cyclic and late-time cosmologies
Classical, semiclassical and source-specific quantum descriptions
assumptions: No common quantum-gravity exclusion principle is imposed.
State selection, observer conditioning, stochastic dynamics and cutoff conditions require separate justification.
conventions: Dimensions, frames, boundary prescriptions, observation events and source dates remain source-specific.
includes: Distinct mechanisms sharing an overview question
excludes: Numerical proximity as evidence of scientific equivalence
Criterion satisfaction as sufficient proof of UV completion
Ancillary particle, communication and historical questions as obligatory core members

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Under what assumption can quantum vacuum correlations be interpreted as the classical primordial fluctuations inferred from observations?

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: How can a theory with many low-energy realizations make falsifiable predictions? The lecture proposes statistical typicality tests and exclusion of unrealizable effective theories, while emphasizing uncertainty about representative samples and broken-supersymmetry vacua.

sources.title: Anthropic bounds on Λ from the no-boundary quantum state

evidence.text: Can anthropic selection be obtained through conditioning in quantum cosmology, and can the no-boundary quantum state provide a prior that restores an order-of-magnitude prediction for Λ when the primordial fluctuation amplitude Q also scans?

sources.title: Is there proof that backreaction of inhomogeneities is irrelevant in cosmology?

evidence.text: Do Green and Wald's results establish that cosmological backreaction is irrelevant, or necessarily represented by a trace-free effective stress tensor, for averaged evolution and observables?

sources.title: A Smooth Exit from Eternal Inflation?

evidence.text: Can a quantum-cosmological, holographic measure determine the global geometry at the exit from scalar-field eternal inflation, and does it favor reasonably smooth universes rather than the highly irregular surfaces predicted by conventional stochastic treatments?

sources.title: de Sitter duality and logarithmic decay of dark energy

evidence.text: Can superhorizon quantum infrared fluctuations in four-dimensional Einstein gravity screen the cosmological constant, account for growing de Sitter entropy, and admit a classical inflation or quintessence description with observable dark-energy evolution?

sources.title: Rollercoaster cosmology

evidence.text: Can interrupted, short bursts of accelerated expansion solve the horizon and flatness problems, preserve observed large-scale perturbations, and produce distinguishable signatures beyond CMB scales?

sources.title: Asymptotic observables and the swampland

evidence.text: Can an observer in an expanding universe perform measurements with unlimited precision, and can a late-time census define probabilities across an eternally inflating landscape?

sources.title: Weyl Curvature Hypothesis in Light of Quantum Backreaction at Cosmological Singularities or Bounces

evidence.text: Can quantum-field backreaction reconcile Penrose’s Weyl curvature hypothesis (WCH) with irregular classical approaches to cosmological singularities, and promote smooth beginnings, endings or bounces, especially across repeated cosmological cycles?

sources.title: A (Strictly) Contemporary Perspective on Trans-Planckian Censorship

evidence.text: How should a cosmological description interpret late classical observables whose formal mode ancestry lies above its initial ultraviolet cutoff? The problem arises only for suitable expansion and classicalization histories.

sources.title: Uses of complex metrics in cosmology

evidence.text: Which complex cosmological metrics satisfy the LSKSW allowability criterion, and how does restricting to them affect classical transitions, proposed quantum bounces, and definitions of the no-boundary gravitational path integral?

sources.title: Power-law inflation satisfies Penrose’s Weyl curvature hypothesis

evidence.text: Can inflation coexist with Penrose's proposed initially singular, Weyl-flat universe and its arrow of time, and can a quantum-cosmological prescription favor such initial conditions?

sources.title: Holographic origin of TCC and the distance conjecture

evidence.text: Can complete boundary observables constrain cosmological expansion and asymptotic particle masses, thereby explaining parts of TCC and the distance conjecture?

sources.title: Review of the no-boundary wave function

evidence.text: Can the no-boundary proposal specify a quantum state and relative initial-condition probabilities, avoid the big bang singularity, and explain classical spacetime and primordial perturbations? The review examines implementations and their unresolved interpretation.

sources.title: A small Universe

evidence.text: Can a complete cosmological model favour a universe only modestly larger than the observable region, and can no-boundary probabilities combined with geometric allowability explain nearly minimal inflation?

sources.title: The boundary proposal

evidence.text: If quantum gravity admits end-of-the-world branes, can an initial spacelike boundary provide an alternative to no-boundary creation of a closed universe, and how do brane tension and the instanton sign prescription affect relative creation weights?

sources.title: Stochastic Survival near Swampland Boundaries

evidence.text: Given independently justified stochastic dynamics and operational EFT-control conditions, what fraction of fluctuating cosmological histories remain controlled for a prescribed duration, when do they fail, and how does survival conditioning bias their dynamics?

sources.title: Cosmological dark energy: Prospects for a dynamical theory

evidence.text: Can horizon-scale quantum fluctuations, particularly those generated by the trace anomaly, dynamically screen cosmological vacuum energy without ultraviolet fine tuning, and yield observable conformal signatures in the CMB?

sources.title: On the Back reaction problem for gravitational perturbations

evidence.text: How can cosmological perturbation back reaction be described by a gauge-independent effective energy-momentum tensor using spatial averaging at each time, including frozen wavelengths beyond the horizon?

sources.title: M theory observables for cosmological space-times

evidence.text: What cosmological analogues of scattering observables can describe Big-Bang universes approaching expanding FRW geometries with Λ ≥ 0, and what quantum description can supply their initial states?

sources.title: A Cyclic model of the universe

evidence.text: Can an indefinitely repeating cosmology generate homogeneity, flatness, density perturbations, and renewed matter/radiation without inflation, while avoiding divergent matter temperature and density at each crunch-to-bang transition?

sources.title: Holographic cosmology 3.0

evidence.text: Can a holographic, maximally entropic early universe produce a surviving normal cosmology, explain homogeneity and flatness, and generate the CMB fluctuations discussed in 2003 with only a short subsequent inflationary era?

sources.title: Cosmological landscape from nothing: Some like it hot

evidence.text: Can self-consistent thermal radiation and conformal-anomaly back reaction remove the Hartle-Hawking small-Λ infrared catastrophe, bound the allowed cosmological instantons, and provide a possible vacuum-selection mechanism?

sources.title: Smooth 'creation' of an open universe in five-dimensions

evidence.text: Can a smooth five-dimensional completion justify Hawking–Turok-type singular instantons and describe open-universe creation while replacing the reported unsuppressed flat-space instability with a sufficiently small decay rate?

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Specify component equations of state and initial densities, integrate conservation separately, sum densities, and integrate the Friedmann equation. Equality epochs follow by equating component densities rather than by assuming continued single-component dominance through the transition.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Cosmological Constant

evidence.text: Approximate a thin energy shell by its continuum volume and compare that volume with a lattice cell. The operation estimates configuration abundance, with arithmetic and degeneracy checks needed for claims about actual nearby energy levels.

sources.title: Anthropic bounds on Λ from the no-boundary quantum state

evidence.text: The local selection probability is approximated by Pg(Dloc) f(Λ,Q,t0) θ(t0−tC), where f is the fraction of protons in galaxies and tC is a classical collapse time. This connects the quantum probabilities to approximate galaxy-formation calculations.

sources.title: Is there proof that backreaction of inhomogeneities is irrelevant in cosmology?

evidence.text: Compare local and spatially averaged Raychaudhuri equations using expansion invariants and the noncommutation of averaging with time evolution. Expansion variance supplies a contribution absent from the corresponding local equation.

sources.title: A Smooth Exit from Eternal Inflation?

evidence.text: Complex-time representations of no-boundary saddle points relate inflationary histories to interior, locally Euclidean AdS domain walls. Euclidean AdS/CFT then supplies the large-three-volume holographic wave-function representation used in the analysis.

sources.title: de Sitter duality and logarithmic decay of dark energy

evidence.text: Evaluate the one-loop effective action in a background gauge through field-pair contractions. Retain massless minimally coupled modes and discard conformally coupled modes with m²=2H² for leading infrared logarithms. Twice-differentiated propagators, gauge-fixing terms and the massive ghost sector do not contribute these logarithms in the stated treatment.

sources.title: Holographic cosmology solutions of problems with pre-inflationary cosmology

evidence.text: Can holographic cosmology with a perturbative three-dimensional QFT dual resolve the classic hot Big Bang puzzles, particularly monopole dilution, during a strongly coupled, non-geometric early phase?

sources.title: Asymptotic observables and the swampland

evidence.text: Where should an observer reside to accumulate sufficiently many observations in an eternally inflating cosmology?

sources.title: Disturbing implications of a cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can conventional quantum mechanics, holography and horizon complementarity in a universe with a fundamental positive cosmological constant explain, or at least accommodate, an inflationary low-entropy beginning and the observed kind of cosmological history?

sources.title: Quantum Breaking Bound on de Sitter and Swampland

evidence.text: Must a consistent cosmological history avoid the loss of its semiclassical de Sitter description? The paper assumes that it must, while acknowledging that a future-eternal quantum state beyond the break-time has not been excluded from first principles.

sources.title: Fuzzy Instantons in Landscape and Swampland: Review of the Hartle–Hawking Wave Function and Several Applications

evidence.text: Which potentials permit classical histories from Hartle–Hawking fuzzy instantons, do their probabilities favor sufficient inflation, and can fast-roll hilltops or extensions beyond the no-boundary proposal accommodate conjectural quantum-gravity constraints?

sources.title: Catastrophic production of slow gravitinos

evidence.text: Could quantum-gravity consistency exclude cosmological effective theories whose gravitino develops a catastrophic production episode?

sources.title: A model with cosmological Bell inequalities

evidence.text: Could cosmological observations violate a Bell inequality and thereby distinguish quantum production of primordial fluctuations from local classical statistical alternatives, despite the practical inability to measure the curvature perturbation's conjugate momentum?

sources.title: From Planck data to Planck era: Observational tests of Holographic Cosmology

evidence.text: Can the primordial spectrum predicted by perturbative holographic cosmology compete observationally with the ΛCDM power law, and can cosmological measurements discriminate among the proposed three-dimensional dual QFTs?

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: Does the anisotropic infinite-past boundary end spacetime or admit a larger extension?

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: How do curvature corrections change finite-action restrictions near a putative big bang?

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: What restrictions on cosmological histories follow from meaningful semiclassical amplitudes between an initial configuration and present field values?

sources.title: Geodesic completeness, cosmological bounces, and inflation

evidence.text: What condition on averaged expansion reliably implies past geodesic incompleteness, and what bounce, emergent or increasing-Hubble phases are required for complete cosmological histories?

sources.title: Is the trans-Planckian censorship a swampland conjecture?

evidence.text: Does prohibiting trans-Planckian fluctuations from becoming classical constrain complete effective theories, or selected cosmological histories? An unobserved allowed history could exclude a theory and thereby restrict its observable predictions.

sources.title: Backreaction of super-Hubble cosmological perturbations beyond perturbation theory

evidence.text: Can super-Hubble scalar cosmological fluctuations decrease an observer-defined expansion rate beyond an expansion in fluctuation amplitude, and thereby support dynamical relaxation of a large bare cosmological constant?

sources.title: Higher-dimensional view on quantum cosmology

evidence.text: Can higher-dimensional physics supply the physical input needed to select the amplitude weighting of a four-dimensional quantum-cosmological wave function?

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: Should a theory predicting many intelligent jovians be penalized because humans would be a minority? The example isolates that question by specifying an observed human count while leaving the jovian population unmeasured.

sources.title: Quantum gravity slows inflation

evidence.text: Can infrared quantum-gravitational back-reaction screen a positive cosmological constant, and at what rate does it change the expansion of an initially inflating universe?

sources.title: Interplay between Swampland and Bayesian Machine Learning in constraining cosmological models

evidence.text: Can inequalities proposed as quantum-gravity consistency conditions supply useful constraints on a cosmological expansion history before observational data enter the analysis, and can those constraints predict subsequent agreement with expansion-rate observations?

sources.title: Fakeons and the classicization of quantum gravity: the FLRW metric

evidence.text: How does projecting fake degrees of freedom out of a quantum theory determine its classical limit, and when can that perturbative projection be resummed exactly for FLRW cosmology rather than yielding only asymptotic classical equations?

sources.title: Quantum Effects in Cosmology

evidence.text: How do quantum fluctuations affect contracting cosmological backgrounds, and can quantum bouncing models support primordial magnetogenesis and a consistent affine quantization of Brans–Dicke cosmology?

sources.title: Decoupling in an expanding universe: Backreaction barely constrains short distance effects in the CMB

evidence.text: Can high-energy corrections to cosmological initial conditions produce observable CMB signatures while respecting gravitational backreaction, and over what time interval is the boundary effective theory valid?

sources.title: Geodesically Complete Universe

evidence.text: Can analytic cosmological solutions be continued through zero scale factor into a geodesically complete classical description, and what roles do Weyl symmetry, anisotropy, radiation and antigravity play?

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: How can a locally flat quotient model a big crunch, big bang and chronology violation? Misner space identifies points by a discrete boost, producing shrinking spatial circles in two wedges and compact timelike circles in the other two.

sources.title: Holographic (eternal) inflation

evidence.text: Can complex ABJM deformations provide holographic quantum-cosmological initial conditions for scalar-driven eternal inflation, including a measure and restrictions on classical cosmological histories?

sources.title: Perfect Quantum Cosmological Bounce

evidence.text: Can quantum cosmology with conformal matter admit unambiguous, unitary evolution across a classical big-bang singularity through analytic continuation along complex classical paths?

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: What warrants a typicality assumption: observed populations, a conjectured prediction, or preference? The source separates these grounds and emphasizes that choosing a class already affects whether humans appear typical.

sources.title: Regular Black Hole Interior Spacetime Supported by Three-Form Field

evidence.text: Previous cosmological and black-hole uses of form fields motivate testing a self-interacting three-form as a classical source for singularity avoidance.

sources.title: On Efforts to Decouple Early Universe Cosmology and Quantum Gravity Phenomenology

evidence.text: Does generalized cosmic censorship justify pursuing early-universe cosmology independently of quantum-gravity phenomenology, and what assumptions about information propagation underlie an everywhere-classical resolution of the Big Bang?

sources.title: Fakeons and microcausality: light cones, gravitational waves and the Hubble constant

evidence.text: Can the classical microcausality violation induced by fakeon projection become observable or propagate to macroscopic distances through light-cone effects, Lorentz boosts or gravitational radiation, and how does cosmological expansion affect it?

sources.title: Evolution of Universes in Causal Set Cosmology

evidence.text: How could a universe born at a black-hole singularity be represented within causal-set theory, and what effective Classical Sequential Growth dynamics would govern its descendants? Could the resulting parameter changes support aspects of Cosmological Natural Selection?

sources.title: De Sitter Space and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a local scalar excitation prepare a causally isolated accelerating region inside an initially smooth asymptotically flat universe?

sources.title: The Axidental Universe

evidence.text: Can random multi-axion landscapes account for the small cosmological constant and approximately observed expansion history when cosmological histories are conditioned on forming nonlinear structure?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship conjecture from the swampland distance conjecture

evidence.text: Does the emergence of light states at large scalar-field distance constrain cosmological expansion strongly enough to prevent initially trans-Planckian fluctuations from crossing the Hubble horizon?

sources.title: Back reaction of cosmological perturbations and the cosmological constant problem

evidence.text: Can accumulated infrared cosmological fluctuations change the inflationary background, dynamically reduce a cosmological constant, and produce effects measurable through a local expansion observable?

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: Can the abundance of observers unlike humans invalidate a cosmological theory even when the theory predicts the observations humans actually possess? The answer depends on the comparison class, the observation event, and whether a physical sampling protocol or an explicit prior preference is supplied.

sources.title: Semiclassicality and decoherence of cosmological perturbations

evidence.text: How do vacuum-generated cosmological perturbations acquire semiclassical stochastic behavior and effective decoherence, and how do the Heisenberg mode-function and Schrödinger squeezed-state descriptions express the same predictions?

sources.title: Further Refining Swampland Conjecture on Inflation in General Scalar-Tensor Theories of Gravity

evidence.text: The framework asks how restrictions motivated by quantum gravity constrain scalar potentials used for cosmological inflation.

sources.title: Cosmological consequences of a principle of finite amplitudes

evidence.text: Which early-universe histories admit finite, well-defined semiclassical transition amplitudes to a finite present configuration?

sources.title: Is the trans-Planckian censorship a swampland conjecture?

evidence.text: Can a probability-based UV criterion assume our Universe is typical when its small cosmological constant may require a rare history? The source asks whether anthropic weighting resolves this difficulty or adds another arbitrary ingredient.

sources.title: Quantum Transitions Through Cosmological Singularities

evidence.text: Can semiclassical quantum transitions connect classical cosmological histories across regions where classicality fails, including inflationary throats and would-be singularities, and assign probabilities to the resulting bouncing histories?

sources.title: On the Limits of Effective Quantum Field Theory: Eternal Inflation, Landscapes, and Other Mythical Beasts

evidence.text: Which cosmological properties are imposed rather than explained by initial-state selection? This HST construction assumes flatness, homogeneity, and isotropy while allowing states subject to overlap consistency.

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on No-Boundary Quantum Cosmology

evidence.text: Does the no-boundary distribution prefer histories with sufficient inflation over classical histories that quickly collapse or over direct production of a nearly empty present-vacuum universe?

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Why must an expanding hot Big Bang begin extraordinarily close to spatial flatness to remain nearly flat today?

sources.title: Cosmic eggs to relax the cosmological constant

evidence.text: Can a universe with a small positive cosmological constant emerge from initially compact dimensions of comparable size, replacing an assumed hierarchy L_Λ≫L_KK with quantum-cosmological decompactification and a weighting of histories?

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: Can an earlier accelerating epoch dynamically prepare the spatial flatness and causal correlations required by the later hot Big Bang?

sources.title: Localized gravity, de Sitter, and the Horizon Criterion

evidence.text: Can cosmological horizons consistently define a quantum-gravity exclusion criterion when spacetime has dynamical boundaries, and what asymptotic scalar potentials would the resulting criterion constrain?

sources.title: Swampland Conjectures and Cosmological Expansion

evidence.text: How can an infinitely cyclic model avoid accumulating entropy in each successive cycle? CBE proposes selecting an almost empty causal patch after prolonged accelerated expansion, leaving matter and most entropy outside the contracting subsystem.

sources.title: Lectures on Cosmic Inflation and its Potential Stringy Realizations

evidence.text: How did widely separated last-scattering regions acquire nearly equal temperatures if the decelerating hot Big Bang supplied insufficient causal contact?

sources.title: Tensor instabilities at the end of the ΛCDM universe

evidence.text: Can photon-induced infrared running turn the massive spin-two ghost of higher-derivative gravity into a tachyonic ghost, destabilizing the future ΛCDM universe, and does asymptotic de Sitter curvature invalidate that prediction?

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: Can the cosmological expansion be described below the quantum-gravity cutoff predicted by GMC? The paper imposes H<Λ_QG before deriving positive-energy mass bounds.

sources.title: Antipodal correlation on the meron wormhole and a bang-crunch universe

evidence.text: What do scalar fluctuations and their two-point function reveal about meron-wormhole stability, antipodal identification, and possible quantum observables after continuation to a closed Bang–Crunch universe?
